
### VLAN idea  {.smaller}


* multiple (‘virtual’) local networks over one network
* links/ports either shared or assigned to just one network
* most common implementation: Ethernet 801.1q: 
<hr class="vspace" />
* on shared links, frames tagged with their ‘VLAN ID’ 

   * special case: untagged frames part of VLAN ID 0x0

* tags added/removed when going to unshared links 

   * and broadcast frames filtered out if VLAN ID doesn't match



### Ethernet encapsulation  {.smaller}

![](/encap/texfig/vlan-ethernet-encapsulation.figure.svg)
 

* network IDs (‘VLAN identifiers’) configured by sysadmins 

   * special case: 0x0 = default (untagged), 0xFFF = reserved

* encapsulation typically added/removed by switches
* usually increase in supported frame size to accomodate tag


### configuring Ethernet encapsulation  {.smaller}


* adding/removing VLAN identifiers --- options: 
<hr class="vspace" />
* configure switch to automatically tag input on specific ports and untag output 

   * example: some ports are ‘phone network’, some are ‘desktop network’
   * typically: ports for hosts add/remove tags; for other switches don't

* end-hosts handle tagging/untagging 

   * example: each virtual machine assigned its own tag
   * example: multiple ‘interfaces’, each with own tag + IP address + routing
